statement: DS4 firmware feature 0xA3 is expected as 49 bytes by both pinned Linux consumers and contains host-decoded hardware/firmware version offsets, but no authentic retail report bytes or comprehensive firmware-revision matrix were captured in this corpus.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 2121–2145; hid-sony.c 1893–1915. Do not treat an implementation stub as validated physical firmware identity.
